description: Equipment, nozzle, and valve schedule to seed a SolidWorks 3D CAD model of the AFD-style freeze dryer. All dimensions/ratings are an ILLUSTRATIVE, self-consistent design basis chosen for this package (not confirmed Hosokawa figures, which are not published) - re-derive against your own batch size using file 11's sizing methodology, and pull exact fitting geometry from the cited connection standards rather than the approximate DN sizes given here.

design_basis.batch_capacity: 10-50 kg wet product (illustrative range - re-size per file 11 for your own target)
design_basis.operating_drying_vacuum: 0.04-0.15 mbar (within Hosokawa's own patent-disclosed 5-0.01 mbar range, file 03 SS2a)
design_basis.condenser_temperature: -60 degC continuous ice loading, -75 degC ultimate base (illustrative - size per file 06 refrigeration method)
design_basis.jacket_temperature_range: -60 degC (freezing) to +80 degC (secondary drying); allow design margin to ~+150 degC if SIP-equipped (file 07 SS2, file 23 SS2)
design_basis.heat_transfer_fluid_example: Dow Syltherm XLT or equivalent wide-range silicone HTF (usable range approx -100 to +260 degC) - a real, named, verifiable example; not a confirmed Hosokawa specification

equipment_schedule.design_pressure_jacket_side: FV to +6 to +10 barg (half-pipe coil jacket, file 05 addendum)
equipment_schedule.moc_product_contact: 316L stainless, Ra <= 0.4 um (SF4 electropolished, file 05 SS4 / file 10)
equipment_schedule.notes: External-pressure design per ASME BPVC VIII-1 UG-28/UG-29 or PED/EN13445 (file 05 SS5) - contract to specialist fabricator, file 10

equipment_schedule.description: Agitator drive assembly (motor + VFD + seal/mag-drive housing)
equipment_schedule.design_pressure_process_side: N/A (seal/coupling rated to vessel design pressure)
equipment_schedule.design_temperature: ambient (bearings/motor kept outside cold zone, file 05 SS3)
equipment_schedule.notes: Purchased component (magnetic coupling, mechanical seal, or double-seal + N2 barrier per file 05 addendum) - not fabricated in-house, file 10

equipment_schedule.volume_capacity: sized to filter area needed for product particle size, file 06 SS4
equipment_schedule.notes: Housing fabricated in-house or by specialist shop; filter media purchased/consumable, file 10

equipment_schedule.description: Condenser (refrigerated coil, catches bulk water vapor)
equipment_schedule.volume_capacity: sized per file 11/06 condenser duty method

equipment_schedule.notes: Purchased vendor package - CAD model uses vendor envelope/nozzle drawing, file 10

equipment_schedule.design_temperature: -100 degC to +260 degC (HTF-limited, e.g. Syltherm XLT range)

equipment_schedule.notes: Purchased vendor package; refrigerant work requires certified technician, file 09 SS2

equipment_schedule.design_pressure_process_side: per clean steam supply (typically 2-4 barg saturated)
equipment_schedule.notes: Optional; purchased vendor package, file 07 SS2

nozzle_schedule.connection_standard: Sanitary Tri-Clamp per ISO 2852 / DIN 32676 Series A
nozzle_schedule.gasket_moc: USP Class VI EPDM or PTFE-encapsulated silicone
nozzle_schedule.face_to_face_note: Tri-Clamp is a ferrule/clamp joint, not a flanged spool - take ferrule OD and clamp geometry from ISO 2852/DIN 32676 tables for the chosen DN, not a fixed face-to-face figure

nozzle_schedule.function: Vapor outlet to material collector (PV-102 line)
nozzle_schedule.size_dn_range: DN80-DN150 (size per vacuum conductance calc, file 08 SS6 - larger and shorter is better for vacuum lines)
nozzle_schedule.connection_standard: ISO-K vacuum flange (larger vacuum lines) or Tri-Clamp for smaller pilot units
nozzle_schedule.face_to_face_note: Pull exact ISO-K flange OD/bolt circle from ISO 2861 series dimension tables for the chosen DN - not invented here

nozzle_schedule.function: Vent / vacuum-break inlet (XV-104, via F-101 sterile filter)

nozzle_schedule.gasket_moc: Per vendor - PTFE or EPDM typical

nozzle_schedule.size_dn_range: Sized to selected seal/mag-drive vendor's mounting flange - not a standard sanitary DN
nozzle_schedule.connection_standard: Vendor-specific per magnetic coupling or double mechanical seal selection, file 05 addendum
Tri-Clamp or NPT/BSP threaded instrument connection
Tri-Clamp (low pressure) or welded/threaded per half-pipe jacket design pressure, file 05 addendum
Tri-Clamp instrument tee or dedicated diaphragm-seal boss

nozzle_schedule.size_dn_range: DN100-DN200 (large - sized for powder flow, not liquid flow assumptions)
nozzle_schedule.connection_standard: Sanitary Tri-Clamp for a first build; a split-valve aseptic transfer connection (e.g. an Alpha-Beta-style split butterfly valve) if docking directly to a canister/vial-filler as Hosokawa's own literature describes, file 18 source 21

nozzle_schedule.size_dn_range: DN25-DN40 (per relief device vendor sizing - a real relief calc, not a nominal guess)

valve_schedule.type: Control valve, diaphragm or globe body
valve_schedule.fail_position: Fail-Closed (FC) recommended - loses jacket flow safely on air/signal loss
valve_schedule.connection: Tri-Clamp or flanged per line size

valve_schedule.actuation: Pneumatic modulating with positioner, or electric motorized actuator
valve_schedule.fail_position: Fail-Open (FO) to atmosphere side is NOT appropriate here (would break vacuum uncontrolled) - Fail-Closed or Fail-Last-Position recommended; confirm against your specific safe-state analysis
valve_schedule.connection: Per N2 vacuum line connection standard

valve_schedule.fail_position: Fail-Closed (FC) as default; some designs prefer Fail-Open here as a passive vacuum-break on air/power loss - a deliberate safety design decision, not a default, see file 09

valve_schedule.actuation: Pneumatic, spring-return or double-acting per vendor
valve_schedule.connection: Per N12 line - sanitary or split-valve aseptic docking
Small-bore Tri-Clamp or push-fit instrument fitting

valve_schedule.type: Vacuum relief valve (passive, spring or weight-loaded)
